title: Gionatan Nese — projects grid and pages on a sideways track
note: Projects is a 3-column grid of tall images with 4px gutters, a centred grotesk + serif header, and a two-face caption under each image (name in the grotesk 13px, disciplines in Teodor). Hovering shows a "View" label at the cursor; unfinished ones get a small "Coming Soon" tag pill top left. Pages live in a flex row of 100vw page roots (data-page-root): on navigation the new page slides in from the right while the old one stays, and the nav pill and loader counter run again. Case pages are a stack of full-bleed images with a "Project Info" pill top left. Worth reusing: the sideways page track and the tag pills in the same frosted style as the nav.
